definitions.explanation: A person who attended the same school. Often used as a modifier in compounds like {同窓会|どうそうかい} (alumni reunion).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同窓|どうそう}だ。
examples.english: He and I are high school classmates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同窓会|どうそうかい}→同窓会：15875_dousoukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。

{同窓|どうそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: I heard from a school friend after a long time, and we had a great time reminiscing.

notes:
Literally "same window" (⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ same + {窓|そう} window), referring to students who studied at the same place. Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{同窓会|どうそうかい}→同窓会：15875_dousoukai⟧ (alumni reunion, class reunion), which is an important social tradition in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{同窓会|どうそうかい}→同窓会：15875_dousoukai⟧: alumni reunion; class reunion
- ⟦{同窓生|どうそうせい}→同窓生：21773_dousousei⟧: fellow alumnus; classmate
- {同窓|どうそう}⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧: alumni directory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧: classmate — specifically someone in the same grade/year
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: colleague from the same entering class — common in companies and organizations
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧/⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧: senior/junior — based on year, not just same school
